Re:   Maine Community Health Options v. United States, No. 18-1023 

  Moda Health Plan, Inc. v. United States, No. 18-1028 

Land of Lincoln Mutual Health Insurance Co. v. United States, No. 18-1038 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent the petitioners in Moda Health Plan, Inc. v. United States, No. 18-1028.  On 

behalf of all parties in the above-captioned consolidated cases, I am writing to request an 
extension of time for the merits briefs in these cases, as follows: 

Petitioners’ briefs: 

Respondent’s briefs: 

August 30, 2019 

October 21, 2019 

All parties have agreed to this proposed schedule, which would allow the Court to hold oral 
argument during the December sitting.  Please let me know if you need any additional 
information. 

Sincerely,  

Paul D. Clement 
Counsel for Petitioners
